selected_script.angle: Greasy rings around stove control knobs make a damp cotton swab look useful at first, but it only lifts a little yellow oil and leaves a sticky cloudy circle until Liapu is sprayed onto a paper towel and wiped on the same spot for a clear no-residue result.
selected_script.hook: This greasy ring around my stove knob is not coming off with just a wet cotton swab.

timeline.0-3s: Extreme close-up of a sticky yellow-brown grease ring around a stainless stove control knob; a wet cotton swab rubs the ring but only turns yellow and leaves the grease visible.
timeline.3-6s: The same cotton swab keeps scrubbing harder around the knob base, spreading cloudy residue into a wider circle while the hand pauses with visible frustration.
timeline.6-10s: Liapu enters naturally, sprayed onto a folded paper towel, then wipes the same greasy ring clean; camera proves the result with a side-by-side untreated edge, a fingertip touch test, and a light spoken CTA.

scenes.promptText:
Create one complete approximately 10-second vertical 9:16 TikTok-style UGC cleaning ad, realistic handheld phone-shot style in a normal US home kitchen, natural counter clutter kept minimal, no UI, no subtitles, no stickers, no text overlays, no watermarks. Preserve the Liapu 500ml Kitchen Spray Cleaner & Degreaser identity exactly from the provided reference images: white smooth plastic cylindrical spray bottle, translucent body with visible liquid level, ergonomic grip, trigger sprayer and nozzle, yellow front-center label with CLEAN UP KITCHEN OIL STAINS and NET: 500ml, correct 500ml proportions, correct label placement, correct plastic material. Do not alter color, shape, material, label, bottle proportions, sprayer structure, or visible product details. Do not invent accessories, extra buttons, lights, ports, decorations, packaging changes, or new functions. No magical cleanup, no exaggerated chemical effects, no foam explosion, no animated germs, no split-screen graphic layout.

0-3s: Start with an extreme close-up macro POV of a stainless steel stove control knob area after cooking. There is a realistic sticky yellow-brown grease ring and small oily specks around the base of one knob. A bare hand uses a wet cotton swab, a familiar ordinary cleaning method, rubbing the grease ring in small circles. The cotton tip turns yellow, but the ring remains visible and the surface still looks tacky. Handheld phone focus hunts slightly, with natural kitchen light and soft appliance reflections. Spoken UGC voiceover in casual American English: “This little grease ring around my stove knob would not come off with just water.”

3-6s: Continue on the same exact stain and same camera angle. The hand keeps scrubbing harder with the wet cotton swab around the knob base. The cotton swab bends slightly from pressure, yellow residue spreads into a wider cloudy smear, and the person gives a tiny frustrated pause, showing that the ordinary method is making the area look streakier instead of clean. Keep it credible and physical: visible effort, residue, smearing, no dramatic effects. Voiceover: “The more I rubbed, the more it just smeared into this cloudy sticky circle.”

6-10s: The Liapu bottle enters naturally from the side, held in the same kitchen by the same hand, label facing camera briefly and clearly while preserving the product identity. For realistic control-panel cleaning, the person sprays Liapu once or twice onto a folded white paper towel, not directly into the knob mechanism, then wipes the same greasy ring around the knob with moderate pressure. The grease lifts gradually onto the towel; the wiped half becomes clean and reflective while a small untreated edge remains visible for credible before-after contrast in the same frame. Finish with a quick fingertip touch test on the cleaned area showing no slippery film, then a short product hold beside the cleaned knob with the yellow label facing the camera. Voiceover: “Liapu cut through it fast, and it didn’t leave that greasy film. Try it for your kitchen cleanup.”

Maintain realistic handheld phone-shot UGC pacing, slight natural camera shake, real wiping sounds, spray sound, normal kitchen ambience, and believable cleaning action on the same stain. The product must remain a kitchen cleaning spray only. Do not show platform interface elements, captions, subtitles, stickers, text overlays, watermarks, poster graphics, arrows, labels, icons, bacteria visuals, invented accessories, product drift, impossible instant transformation, or exaggerated chemical reactions.
